items.question: Which WNBA teams has Jaylyn Sherrod played for?
items.answer: Jaylyn Sherrod has played for the New York Liberty, Minnesota Lynx, Atlanta Dream and Seattle Storm.

items.question: How did Jaylyn Sherrod play in 2026?
items.answer: In 2026, Jaylyn Sherrod averaged 1.9 points, 0.9 rebounds and 1.1 assists in 13 regular-season games: 10 for the Atlanta Dream and three for the Seattle Storm.

items.question: Did Jaylyn Sherrod win a championship with the Liberty?
items.answer: Yes. Jaylyn Sherrod won the 2024 WNBA championship with the New York Liberty as a rookie. The Liberty first signed her to a training camp contract in April 2024.

items.question: Was Jaylyn Sherrod drafted?
items.answer: No. Jaylyn Sherrod went undrafted in 2024 and signed a training camp contract with the New York Liberty on April 16, 2024.

items.question: Where did Jaylyn Sherrod play college basketball?
items.answer: Jaylyn Sherrod played at Colorado from 2019 to 2024. She was a two-time All-Pac-12 selection and made the Pac-12 All-Defensive Team three times.

items.question: How tall is Jaylyn Sherrod?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Jaylyn Sherrod at 5 feet 7 inches and 147 pounds. She plays guard.
